claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a double burner industrial gas stove with a welded frame and control valves.

risks.risk: Burners may be clogged or have poor gas flow.
risks.proof: A video clip showing both burners lit and producing a steady blue flame.

risks.risk: Gas leaks in the manifold or valves.
risks.proof: A video of a soapy water test on all pipe joints and valves while under pressure.

risks.risk: Structural weakness or rusted-through frame members.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the underside and weld points.
A photo showing the regulator and hose connected to the unit.

proof_requests: Video of both burners lit and operating.
Video of a soapy water leak test on the gas assembly.
Close-up photos of the frame welds and the underside of the burners.
Photo of the gas hose and regulator if they are included in the sale.
response.reason: The witness has confirmed the identity of the item as a double burner industrial gas stove, which allows for a worst-case valuation.
